# Indian Invention Boy: Product and Price Reference

Indian Invention Boy sells gold and silver home décor. Prices come from the product price list in Indian Rupees (₹). Enquiries are made on WhatsApp at +91 63966 39864.

## Ordering
- Choose a piece from the catalogue and note its catalogue number.
- Send an enquiry on WhatsApp, or use the quote request form for several pieces.
- The conversation continues on WhatsApp.
